newsitem.title: FINLAND: Borealis, Ashland in sales pact.
newsitem.headline: Borealis, Ashland in sales pact.

text.p: Borealis, the chemicals joint venture part-owned by Finland's Neste Oy, said on Friday it had signed a letter of intent on cooperation in polyolefin plastics sales with Ashland Plastics of the United States.
"Borealis and Ashland Plastics have today signed a letter of intent, which comprises a plan about the European wide polyolefin sales to Borealis' small customers," Borealis said in a statement.
Ashland will handle sales and technical customer support for about 1,500 Borealis customers in Europe.
The agreement will take effect later this year, Borealis said.
"The purpose of this cooperation is to improve Borealis' customer service," it said.

Ashland Plastics, which is one of divisions in Ashland Chemicals, is the biggest delivery company in North America, with operations also in Great Britain, Ireland, France, Italy and Benelux countries, Borealis said.
"Due to its long experience Ashland Plastics is able to have closer cooperation with Borealis's clients and can ensure them shorter delivery times," it said.
